title: Count Vowels in Every Window of K
statement: Given a string s and integer k, return the vowel count for each substring window of length k.
think: What is the task asking? Given a string s and integer k, return the vowel count for each substring window of length k.
What is the key operation? Identify the repeated action over the input.
What wording signals stand out? window size k, substring, count in every window.
What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a clean sliding window solution.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
How would I explain it in an interview? State the pattern, the key operation, and the complexity.
algorithm: Compute vowel count in first window
Slide window one char at a time
Add incoming char, remove outgoing char
interview: I would solve it using Sliding Window. I would first identify the core operation, then apply a simple sliding window approach and mention the complexity.
